description: REQUIRES prior hometax__session__login call with same account_link_id. Search tax amounts due by payment deadline (납부할 세액 조회). Read-only: this tool never executes a payment; the 'or_pay' in its name is historical. Files: a document generated from this result, as Excel (xlsx) only when requested in output_formats, listed in artifacts[] of the result with a download_url that works for 15 minutes; each file is kept for 7 days. If a link has expired, call xdata__job__result with the job_id from the result for fresh links.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

inqr_cl_cd.description: Lookup mode (조회구분코드). Optional. '01' shows only items whose payment deadline has passed.

output_formats.description: Optional. Also return this result as a file (Excel (xlsx)) in artifacts[] of the result. Omit it for data only.

name: hometax__tax__payment_due__search_or_pay
title: 납부기한 조회/납부
